essence: The practitioner should arrange the forthcoming diagram in the center according to rule
The persons to be worshipped must be auspicious, anointed with sandal and saffron, and beautiful in all limbs
One should worship them properly with scented sacred lotuses
One should have a shining lotus made there in the middle of the pericarp
The specified fragrant substances are khadira, usira, saffron, sandal, aguru, and tamala
